== Biography ==

== Trivia ==
* Nicknamed '''Elpoya''' by the Spanish community. Also call him '''Elyayo''' when he plays especially bad.
* Part of a select group of players called "Royal Roaders", earned after winning their rookie split in a major region ([[LEC/2021 Season/Spring Playoffs|LEC Spring 2021]]).

=== Individual Awards ===
* LEC Finals MVP (Spring 2025)
* 3x LEC 1st All-Pro Team (Summer 2022, Winter 2023, Spring 2023)
* 3x LEC 3rd All-Pro Team (Spring 2021, Spring 2022, Spring 2025)
* LEC Rookie of the Split (Spring 2021)
* Superliga Finals MVP (Summer 2020)
* Superliga MVP (Summer 2020)
* Superliga Rookie of the Split (Spring 2020)
